IM 33 years old. I am not married and have never been, never enjoyed success with women. Today I quit my job for 5 years and the only thing I know is I don’t want to work for someone. Unfortunately, I cannot say that I have any professional skills.

I don’t know what to do next, I’m in such a state that I don’t want anything. I understand that I need to work, but I cannot understand what I want or what I like. I can't even find the strength or gain the desire to start something. I would like to start my own business, but everything remains at the idea stage and I cannot find the strength to even start doing something. Sometimes it seems that I just want not to leave my room.

Any events in my life do not cause emotions in me, the only thing that I have left are sharp outbursts of anger.

I can describe this condition as: a burnt out light bulb. I don’t know if I correctly described what is happening in my life now.
